summary: Innovation is a fast, brain-burning card game where you build tech trees and constantly steal or copy each other's effects via chained 'dogma' actions, so a quiet turn can suddenly cascade into your opponent's cards firing repeatedly against you. This Ultimate edition bundles the base game with all five expansions plus a new Age 11 and reworked rules, making an already dense engine even bigger and more combo-laden.
praised: Explosive, satisfying combos and chain reactions once you see the engine click
Extremely fast to play despite deep strategic depth
High replayability from asymmetric card effects and splaying
Clever theme expressed through card icons and history-themed names
This edition's rules streamlining and consolidation of all expansions in one box
criticised: Steep learning curve; card text is famously hard to parse for new players
Can feel like solitaire with occasional interference rather than direct interaction
Snowballing/kingmaking issues, especially at higher player counts
Analysis paralysis from tracking everyone's board and available dogma actions
Adding all expansions plus Age 11 raises complexity/rules overhead further

interaction.kind: sharing and stealing dogma effects, take-that card/resource disruption

scoring.why: Winning comes from reaching achievement thresholds or accumulating enough score-value icons through a tuned tech-tree engine, not from summing unrelated scoring categories
